story.title: Our Story
story.content:
PinDownloader was created with a simple mission: to make downloading Pinterest content easy, fast, and accessible to everyone. We noticed that many existing tools were complicated, filled with ads, or required unnecessary registrations. We wanted to create something better.

Since our launch, we've helped millions of users download their favorite Pinterest content. Whether you're a content creator, designer, marketer, or just someone who loves collecting inspiration, we're here to make your life easier.

Our team is dedicated to maintaining a fast, reliable, and user-friendly service. We continuously improve our platform based on user feedback and the latest technology.

legal.title: Legal & DMCA
legal.content:
PinDownloader respects intellectual property rights and complies with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA). We provide tools for personal use and fair use purposes only.

Users are responsible for ensuring they have the right to download and use any content. We do not host, store, or distribute any content - we simply provide a tool to access publicly available content from Pinterest.

If you believe your copyrighted work has been downloaded through our service in a way that constitutes copyright infringement, please contact us with a DMCA notice at our support email.
